answer: Identity bonds that decay stop mass fake identities. To join the market, an agent buys a 100 POA bond before its first voyage: the bond loses 5 POA per epoch and dies after 20 epochs unless renewed. A sybil attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must pay 100,000 POA, then 5,000 POA per epoch to keep them alive on the ridge of renewal, while honest agents pay once and earn far more than the 5 POA upkeep. Through a prism of cost, fakes are a losing trade.
